title: Conversion to strict circuit size
statement: Let $T : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and let $L$ be a language of Boolean strings. If $L$ is recognized by a circuit family with fan-in at most two and size at most $T(n)$ on inputs of length $n$, then it is recognized by a family whose circuit at length zero has fan-in at most two and whose circuits at every positive input length are strict: each gate has distinct inputs and has exactly one input if it is a NOT gate and exactly two otherwise, and every vertex other than the output has positive fanout. The size at input length $n$ is at most $4T(n)+12$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is in circuit size $T$ with fan-in at most two
